006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDayTimeDurationItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDurationItem;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IIntegerItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IYearMonthDurationItem;
021import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
022
023/**
024 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
025 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-hours-from-duration">fn:hours-from-duration</a>.
026 * function.
027 */
028public final class FnHoursFromDuration {
029  private static final String NAME = "hours-from-duration";
030  @NonNull
031  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
032      .name(NAME)
033      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
034      .deterministic()
035      .contextIndependent()
036      .focusIndependent()
037      .argument(IArgument.builder()
038          .name("arg")
039          .type(IDurationItem.type())
040          .zeroOrOne()
041          .build())
042      .returnType(IIntegerItem.type())
043      .returnZeroOrOne()
044      .functionHandler(FnHoursFromDuration::execute)
045      .build();
046
047  private FnHoursFromDuration() {
048    // disable construction
049  }
050
051  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
052  @NonNull
053  private static ISequence<IIntegerItem> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
054      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
055      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
056      IItem focus) {
057    IDurationItem arg = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true));
058    return arg == null
059        // Per spec, return empty sequence if the arg is null
060        ? ISequence.empty()
061        : arg instanceof IYearMonthDurationItem
062            // year-month durations do not have hour granularity
063            ? ISequence.of(IIntegerItem.ZERO)
064            // get the hours
065            : ISequence.of(fnHoursFromDuration((IDayTimeDurationItem) arg));
066  }
067
068  /**
069   * Implements <a href=
070   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-hours-from-duration">fn:hours-from-duration</a>.
071   *
072   * @param arg
073   *          the meta:duration item from which to extract the hour component
074   * @return the hour component from the duration as an integer item
075   */
076  @NonNull
077  public static IIntegerItem fnHoursFromDuration(@NonNull IDayTimeDurationItem arg) {
078    long seconds = arg.asSeconds();
079    return IIntegerItem.valueOf(seconds % 86_400 / 3_600);
080  }
081}
